Question: Which Technology companies expanded operating margins the most between FY2022 and FY2023?
Business_context: Rank large-cap Technology names by operating leverage gains in the latest fiscal year.
SQL_generated:
WITH sector_companies AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT cik, name
    FROM companies
    WHERE gics_sector = 'Information Technology'
),
annual_filings AS (
    SELECT s.adsh, s.cik, CAST(s.fy AS INTEGER) AS fiscal_year, s.period,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.cik, s.fy ORDER BY s.filed DESC) AS rn
    FROM sub s
    JOIN sector_companies sc USING (cik)
    WHERE s.form IN ('10-K','10-K/A')
      AND s.fy IN (2022, 2023)
),
latest AS (
    SELECT adsh, cik, fiscal_year, period
    FROM annual_filings
    WHERE rn = 1
),
values AS (
    SELECT lf.cik, lf.fiscal_year,
           MAX(CASE WHEN n.tag = 'OperatingIncomeLoss' THEN n.value END) AS operating_income,
           MAX(CASE WHEN n.tag IN ('Revenues','RevenueFromContractWithCustomerExcludingAssessedTax','SalesRevenueNet') THEN n.value END) AS revenue
    FROM latest lf
    JOIN num n ON n.adsh = lf.adsh AND n.ddate = lf.period
    WHERE n.tag IN ('OperatingIncomeLoss','Revenues','RevenueFromContractWithCustomerExcludingAssessedTax','SalesRevenueNet')
    GROUP BY lf.cik, lf.fiscal_year
),
agg AS (
    SELECT sc.cik, ANY_VALUE(sc.name) AS display_name,
           MAX(CASE WHEN v.fiscal_year = 2022 THEN v.operating_income / NULLIF(v.revenue, 0) END) AS margin_2022,
           MAX(CASE WHEN v.fiscal_year = 2023 THEN v.operating_income / NULLIF(v.revenue, 0) END) AS margin_2023,
           MAX(CASE WHEN v.fiscal_year = 2023 THEN v.revenue END) AS revenue_2023
    FROM values v
    JOIN sector_companies sc USING (cik)
    GROUP BY sc.cik
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT v.fiscal_year) = 2
)
SELECT display_name AS name,
       ROUND(margin_2022 * 100, 2) AS margin_2022_pct,
       ROUND(margin_2023 * 100, 2) AS margin_2023_pct,
       ROUND((margin_2023 - margin_2022) * 100, 2) AS improvement_pp,
       ROUND(revenue_2023 / 1000000000, 2) AS revenue_2023_b
FROM agg
WHERE revenue_2023 >= 5000000000
  AND margin_2023 IS NOT NULL AND margin_2022 IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY improvement_pp DESC
LIMIT 10;
Answer_expected: Fidelity National Information Services (+125.9pp), NVIDIA (+35.3pp), Salesforce (+11.1pp), DoorDash (+10.4pp), Meta Platforms (+10.0pp), and Palo Alto Networks (+9.1pp) lead once a $5B revenue floor is applied.
Answer_received: FIS (+125.9pp), NVIDIA (+35.3pp), Salesforce (+11.1pp), DoorDash (+10.4pp), Meta (+10.0pp), Palo Alto Networks (+9.1pp); Workday, Fiserv, Hubbell follow once the $5B revenue floor is applied.

Question: Which Technology companies have shown declining ROE over the past 3 years even as revenue kept growing, and how large is the divergence between the two trends?
Business_context: Surface ROE deterioration despite revenue growth to flag efficiency risks.
SQL_generated:
WITH sector_companies AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT cik, name
    FROM companies
    WHERE gics_sector = 'Information Technology'
),
annual_filings AS (
    SELECT s.adsh, s.cik, CAST(s.fy AS INTEGER) AS fiscal_year, s.period,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.cik, s.fy ORDER BY s.filed DESC) AS rn
    FROM sub s
    JOIN sector_companies sc USING (cik)
    WHERE s.form IN ('10-K','10-K/A') AND s.fy BETWEEN 2021 AND 2023
),
latest AS (
    SELECT * FROM annual_filings WHERE rn = 1
),
values AS (
    SELECT lf.cik, lf.fiscal_year,
           MAX(CASE WHEN n.tag = 'NetIncomeLoss' THEN n.value END) AS net_income,
           MAX(CASE WHEN n.tag IN ('StockholdersEquity','StockholdersEquityIncludingPortionAttributableToNoncontrollingInterest') THEN n.value END) AS equity,
           MAX(CASE WHEN n.tag IN ('Revenues','RevenueFromContractWithCustomerExcludingAssessedTax','SalesRevenueNet') THEN n.value END) AS revenue
    FROM latest lf
    JOIN num n ON n.adsh = lf.adsh AND n.ddate = lf.period
    WHERE n.tag IN (
        'NetIncomeLoss','StockholdersEquity','StockholdersEquityIncludingPortionAttributableToNoncontrollingInterest',
        'Revenues','RevenueFromContractWithCustomerExcludingAssessedTax','SalesRevenueNet'
    )
    GROUP BY lf.cik, lf.fiscal_year
),
agg AS (
    SELECT sc.name,
           MAX(CASE WHEN fiscal_year = 2021 THEN net_income / NULLIF(equity,0) END) AS roe_2021,
           MAX(CASE WHEN fiscal_year = 2023 THEN net_income / NULLIF(equity,0) END) AS roe_2023,
           MAX(CASE WHEN fiscal_year = 2021 THEN revenue END) AS revenue_2021,
           MAX(CASE WHEN fiscal_year = 2023 THEN revenue END) AS revenue_2023
    FROM values v
    JOIN sector_companies sc USING (cik)
    GROUP BY sc.name
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN fiscal_year IN (2021,2023) THEN fiscal_year END) = 2
)
SELECT name,
       ROUND(roe_2021 * 100, 2) AS roe_2021_pct,
       ROUND(roe_2023 * 100, 2) AS roe_2023_pct,
       ROUND((roe_2023 - roe_2021) * 100, 2) AS roe_change_pp,
       ROUND(((revenue_2023 - revenue_2021) / NULLIF(revenue_2021, 0)) * 100, 2) AS revenue_growth_pct
FROM agg
WHERE revenue_2023 > revenue_2021 AND roe_2023 < roe_2021
ORDER BY roe_change_pp ASC
LIMIT 10;

Question: Show the working capital trends for Industrial companies from 2020 to 2024, identifying companies with improving cash conversion cycles.
Business_context: Monitor industrial working capital and cash conversion cycle improvements.
SQL_generated:
WITH sector_companies AS (
    SELECT cik, name,
           REGEXP_REPLACE(UPPER(TRIM(name)), '[^A-Z0-9]', '', 'g') AS canonical_name
    FROM companies
    WHERE gics_sector = 'Industrials'
),
annual_filings AS (
    SELECT s.adsh, s.cik, CAST(s.fy AS INTEGER) AS fiscal_year, s.period,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.cik, s.fy ORDER BY s.filed DESC) AS rn
    FROM sub s
    JOIN sector_companies sc USING (cik)
    WHERE s.form IN ('10-K','10-K/A') AND s.fy BETWEEN 2020 AND 2023
),
latest AS (
    SELECT * FROM annual_filings WHERE rn = 1
),
vals AS (
    SELECT lf.cik, lf.fiscal_year,
           MAX(CASE WHEN n.tag = 'AssetsCurrent' THEN n.value END) AS assets_current,
           MAX(CASE WHEN n.tag = 'LiabilitiesCurrent' THEN n.value END) AS liabilities_current,
           MAX(CASE WHEN n.tag IN ('Revenues','RevenueFromContractWithCustomerExcludingAssessedTax','SalesRevenueNet') THEN n.value END) AS revenue,
           MAX(CASE WHEN n.tag IN ('InventoryNet','Inventory') THEN n.value END) AS inventory,
           MAX(CASE WHEN n.tag IN ('AccountsReceivableNetCurrent','AccountsReceivableTradeCurrent') THEN n.value END) AS ar,
           MAX(CASE WHEN n.tag IN ('CostOfGoodsAndServicesSold','CostOfRevenue') THEN n.value END) AS cost_of_revenue,
           MAX(CASE WHEN n.tag IN ('AccountsPayableCurrent','AccountsPayableTradeCurrent') THEN n.value END) AS ap
    FROM latest lf
    JOIN num n ON n.adsh = lf.adsh AND n.ddate = lf.period
    WHERE n.tag IN (
        'AssetsCurrent','LiabilitiesCurrent','Revenues','RevenueFromContractWithCustomerExcludingAssessedTax','SalesRevenueNet',
        'InventoryNet','Inventory','AccountsReceivableNetCurrent','AccountsReceivableTradeCurrent',
        'CostOfGoodsAndServicesSold','CostOfRevenue','AccountsPayableCurrent','AccountsPayableTradeCurrent'
    )
    GROUP BY lf.cik, lf.fiscal_year
),
computed AS (
    SELECT v.cik, v.fiscal_year,
           (assets_current - liabilities_current) / NULLIF(revenue,0) * 365 AS wc_days,
           inventory / NULLIF(cost_of_revenue,0) * 365 AS dio,
           ar / NULLIF(revenue,0) * 365 AS dso,
           ap / NULLIF(cost_of_revenue,0) * 365 AS dpo
    FROM vals v
),
agg AS (
    SELECT sc.canonical_name, ANY_VALUE(sc.name) AS name,
           MAX(CASE WHEN fiscal_year = 2020 THEN wc_days END) AS wc_2020,
           MAX(CASE WHEN fiscal_year = 2023 THEN wc_days END) AS wc_2023,
           MAX(CASE WHEN fiscal_year = 2020 THEN (dio + dso - dpo) END) AS ccc_2020,
           MAX(CASE WHEN fiscal_year = 2023 THEN (dio + dso - dpo) END) AS ccc_2023
    FROM computed c
    JOIN sector_companies sc USING (cik)
    GROUP BY sc.canonical_name
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN fiscal_year IN (2020,2023) THEN fiscal_year END) = 2
)
SELECT name,
       ROUND(wc_2020,2) AS wc_2020_days,
       ROUND(wc_2023,2) AS wc_2023_days,
       ROUND(wc_2023 - wc_2020,2) AS wc_change_days,
       ROUND(ccc_2020,2) AS ccc_2020_days,
       ROUND(ccc_2023,2) AS ccc_2023_days,
       ROUND(ccc_2023 - ccc_2020,2) AS ccc_change_days
FROM agg
WHERE wc_2020 IS NOT NULL AND wc_2023 IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY wc_change_days
LIMIT 10;
Answer_expected: Southwest (-285d), Boeing (-153d), Delta (-133d), CSX (-80d), Illinois Tool Works (-79d), and Lam Research (-90d) now run with materially lower working-capital days; Lam is the only one with full CCC data (164d→223d) showing WIP still elevated.
Answer_received: CLI run surfaced Southwest (-286d), Boeing (-153d), Delta (-133d), Lam Research (-90d) and IDEX (-90d) as the top working-capital compressors between FY2020 and FY2023; CCC data only available for Lam (up +59d).

Question: Identify Energy companies that have maintained ROE above 15% for at least 3 consecutive years between 2020-2024 despite commodity volatility.
Business_context: Flag energy names delivering consecutive 15%+ ROE through commodity swings.
SQL_generated:
WITH sector_companies AS (
    SELECT
        cik,
        name AS display_name,
        REGEXP_REPLACE(UPPER(TRIM(name)), '[^A-Z0-9]', '', 'g') AS canonical_name,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cik ORDER BY name) AS rn
    FROM companies
    WHERE ('Energy' = 'ALL' OR UPPER(gics_sector) = UPPER('Energy'))
),
company_seed AS (
    SELECT cik, display_name, canonical_name
    FROM sector_companies
    WHERE rn = 1
),
annual_filings AS (
    SELECT
        s.adsh,
        s.cik,
        CAST(s.fy AS INTEGER) AS fiscal_year,
        s.period,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.cik, s.fy ORDER BY s.filed DESC) AS rn
    FROM sub s
    JOIN company_seed sc USING (cik)
    WHERE s.form IN ('10-K','10-K/A')
      AND s.fy BETWEEN 2020 AND 2024
),
latest_filings AS (
    SELECT adsh, cik, fiscal_year, period
    FROM annual_filings
    WHERE rn = 1
),
annual_values AS (
    SELECT
        sc.display_name AS company,
        sc.canonical_name,
        lf.cik,
        lf.fiscal_year,
        MAX(CASE WHEN n.tag IN (
            'NetIncomeLoss',
            'NetIncomeLossAvailableToCommonStockholdersBasic',
            'NetIncomeLossAvailableToCommonStockholdersDiluted'
        ) THEN n.value END) AS net_income,
        MAX(CASE WHEN n.tag IN (
            'StockholdersEquity',
            'StockholdersEquityIncludingPortionAttributableToNoncontrollingInterest'
        ) THEN n.value END) AS equity
    FROM latest_filings lf
    JOIN num n ON n.adsh = lf.adsh AND n.ddate = lf.period
    JOIN company_seed sc USING (cik)
    WHERE n.tag IN (
        'NetIncomeLoss',
        'NetIncomeLossAvailableToCommonStockholdersBasic',
        'NetIncomeLossAvailableToCommonStockholdersDiluted',
        'StockholdersEquity',
        'StockholdersEquityIncludingPortionAttributableToNoncontrollingInterest'
    )
      AND COALESCE(TRIM(n.segments), '') = ''
      AND COALESCE(TRIM(n.coreg), '') = ''
    GROUP BY sc.display_name, sc.canonical_name, lf.cik, lf.fiscal_year
),
roe_values AS (
    SELECT
        company,
        canonical_name,
        fiscal_year,
        CASE
            WHEN net_income IS NULL OR equity IS NULL THEN NULL
            WHEN ABS(equity) < 100000000 OR equity <= 0 THEN NULL
            ELSE LEAST(
                150,
                GREATEST(
                    -150,
                    (net_income / NULLIF(equity, 0)) * 100
                )
            )
        END AS roe_pct
    FROM annual_values
),
filtered_years AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM roe_values
    WHERE fiscal_year BETWEEN 2020 AND 2024
      AND roe_pct IS NOT NULL
),
streak_index AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        CASE WHEN roe_pct >= 15 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS above_threshold,
        CASE
            WHEN roe_pct >= 15 THEN fiscal_year - ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                PARTITION BY canonical_name, CASE WHEN roe_pct >= 15 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
                ORDER BY fiscal_year
            )
            ELSE NULL
        END AS streak_group
    FROM filtered_years
),
consecutive_runs AS (
    SELECT
        canonical_name,
        COUNT(*) AS streak_length,
        MIN(fiscal_year) AS streak_start_year,
        MAX(fiscal_year) AS streak_end_year
    FROM streak_index
    WHERE above_threshold = 1
    GROUP BY canonical_name, streak_group
),
longest_streak AS (
    SELECT
        canonical_name,
        streak_length,
        streak_start_year,
        streak_end_year,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY canonical_name
            ORDER BY streak_length DESC, streak_end_year DESC
        ) AS streak_rank
    FROM consecutive_runs
),
company_longest AS (
    SELECT
        canonical_name,
        streak_length AS max_consecutive_years,
        streak_start_year,
        streak_end_year
    FROM longest_streak
    WHERE streak_rank = 1
),
roe_summary AS (
    SELECT
        canonical_name,
        ANY_VALUE(company) AS company,
        COUNT(*) AS years_reported,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE above_threshold = 1) AS years_above_threshold,
        ROUND(AVG(roe_pct) FILTER (WHERE above_threshold = 1), 2) AS avg_roe_pct,
        ROUND(
            COALESCE(
                STDDEV_SAMP(roe_pct) FILTER (WHERE above_threshold = 1),
                0
            ),
            2
        ) AS roe_volatility_pct,
        ROUND(MIN(roe_pct) FILTER (WHERE above_threshold = 1), 2) AS min_streak_roe_pct,
        ROUND(MAX(roe_pct) FILTER (WHERE above_threshold = 1), 2) AS max_streak_roe_pct,
        MIN(fiscal_year) AS first_year,
        MAX(fiscal_year) AS last_year
    FROM streak_index
    GROUP BY canonical_name
),
latest_values AS (
    SELECT
        canonical_name,
        CAST(fiscal_year AS INTEGER) AS fiscal_year,
        roe_pct,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY canonical_name
            ORDER BY fiscal_year DESC
        ) AS rn
    FROM filtered_years
),
latest_per_company AS (
    SELECT
        canonical_name,
        fiscal_year AS latest_year_reported,
        ROUND(roe_pct, 2) AS latest_year_roe_pct
    FROM latest_values
    WHERE rn = 1
),
finalized AS (
    SELECT
        rs.company AS name,
        rs.canonical_name,
        rs.years_reported,
        rs.years_above_threshold,
        COALESCE(cl.max_consecutive_years, 0) AS max_consecutive_years,
        cl.streak_start_year,
        cl.streak_end_year,
        rs.avg_roe_pct,
        rs.roe_volatility_pct,
        rs.min_streak_roe_pct,
        rs.max_streak_roe_pct,
        rs.first_year,
        rs.last_year,
        lp.latest_year_reported,
        lp.latest_year_roe_pct
    FROM roe_summary rs
    LEFT JOIN company_longest cl USING (canonical_name)
    LEFT JOIN latest_per_company lp USING (canonical_name)
)
SELECT
    name,
    max_consecutive_years AS consecutive_years,
    years_above_threshold,
    years_reported,
    streak_start_year,
    streak_end_year,
    first_year,
    last_year,
    avg_roe_pct,
    roe_volatility_pct,
    min_streak_roe_pct,
    max_streak_roe_pct,
    latest_year_reported,
    latest_year_roe_pct
FROM (
    SELECT
        *,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY canonical_name
            ORDER BY
                max_consecutive_years DESC,
                avg_roe_pct DESC,
                roe_volatility_pct ASC,
                name
        ) AS name_rank
    FROM finalized
    WHERE max_consecutive_years >= 3
      AND years_above_threshold >= 3
      AND years_reported >= 3
      AND avg_roe_pct IS NOT NULL
)
WHERE name_rank = 1
ORDER BY
    consecutive_years DESC,
    avg_roe_pct DESC,
    roe_volatility_pct ASC,
    name
LIMIT 10;

Question: How have quarterly cash flows from operations evolved for the top 10 Information Technology companies by FY2023 revenue from 2022 to 2024?
Business_context: Assess operating cash health for technology leaders

WITH sector_companies AS (
    SELECT
        c.cik,
        MIN(c.name) AS company_name,
        REGEXP_REPLACE(UPPER(TRIM(MIN(c.name))), '[^A-Z0-9]', '', 'g') AS canonical_name
    FROM companies c
    WHERE (
        UPPER('Information Technology') = 'ALL'
        OR LOWER(c.gics_sector) LIKE LOWER('%Information Technology%')
    )
    GROUP BY c.cik
),
ranking_filings AS (
    SELECT
        s.adsh,
        s.cik,
        CAST(s.fy AS INTEGER) AS fiscal_year,
        s.period,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY s.cik, s.fy
            ORDER BY s.filed DESC
        ) AS rn
    FROM sub s
    JOIN sector_companies sc USING (cik)
    WHERE s.form IN ('10-K', '10-K/A', '20-F')
      AND CAST(s.fy AS INTEGER) = 2023
),
latest_ranking AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM ranking_filings
    WHERE rn = 1
),
ranking_metrics AS (
    SELECT
        lr.cik,
        COALESCE(
            MAX(CASE WHEN n.tag = 'Revenues' THEN n.value END),
            MAX(CASE WHEN n.tag = 'RevenueFromContractWithCustomerExcludingAssessedTax' THEN n.value END),
            MAX(CASE WHEN n.tag = 'SalesRevenueNet' THEN n.value END),
            MAX(CASE WHEN n.tag = 'NetSalesRevenue' THEN n.value END),
            MAX(CASE WHEN n.tag = 'NetSales' THEN n.value END)
        ) AS revenue
    FROM latest_ranking lr
    JOIN num n ON n.adsh = lr.adsh AND n.ddate = lr.period
    WHERE n.tag IN (
        'Revenues',
        'RevenueFromContractWithCustomerExcludingAssessedTax',
        'SalesRevenueNet',
        'NetSalesRevenue',
        'NetSales'
    )
      AND COALESCE(TRIM(n.segments), '') = ''
      AND COALESCE(TRIM(n.coreg), '') = ''
    GROUP BY lr.cik
),
ranked_companies AS (
    SELECT
        sc.cik,
        sc.company_name,
        sc.canonical_name,
        rm.revenue,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            ORDER BY rm.revenue DESC NULLS LAST, sc.company_name
        ) AS revenue_rank
    FROM ranking_metrics rm
    JOIN sector_companies sc USING (cik)
    WHERE rm.revenue IS NOT NULL
      AND rm.revenue >= 10000000000
),
selected_companies AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM ranked_companies
    WHERE revenue_rank <= 10
),
quarterly_filings AS (
    SELECT
        s.adsh,
        s.cik,
        CAST(s.fy AS INTEGER) AS fiscal_year,
        s.fp,
        s.period AS quarter_end,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY s.cik, s.period
            ORDER BY s.filed DESC
        ) AS filing_rank
    FROM sub s
    JOIN selected_companies sc USING (cik)
    WHERE s.form IN ('10-Q', '10-Q/A')
      AND s.fp IN ('Q1', 'Q2', 'Q3', 'Q4')
      AND CAST(s.fy AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 2022 AND 2024
      AND s.period BETWEEN DATE '2021-09-01' AND DATE '2024-12-31'
),
latest_quarters AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM quarterly_filings
    WHERE filing_rank = 1
),
raw_cfo AS (
    SELECT
        l.cik,
        l.fiscal_year,
        l.fp,
        DATE_TRUNC('day', l.quarter_end) AS quarter_end,
        COALESCE(
            MAX(CASE WHEN n.tag = 'NetCashProvidedByUsedInOperatingActivities' THEN n.value END),
            MAX(CASE WHEN n.tag = 'NetCashProvidedByUsedInOperatingActivitiesContinuingOperations' THEN n.value END),
            MAX(CASE WHEN n.tag = 'NetCashProvidedByUsedInOperatingActivitiesExcludingDiscontinuedOperations' THEN n.value END)
        ) AS cfo_ytd
    FROM latest_quarters l
    JOIN num n ON n.adsh = l.adsh AND n.ddate = l.quarter_end
    WHERE n.tag IN (
        'NetCashProvidedByUsedInOperatingActivities',
        'NetCashProvidedByUsedInOperatingActivitiesContinuingOperations',
        'NetCashProvidedByUsedInOperatingActivitiesExcludingDiscontinuedOperations'

      AND COALESCE(TRIM(n.segments), '') = ''
      AND COALESCE(TRIM(n.coreg), '') = ''
    GROUP BY l.cik, l.fiscal_year, l.fp, l.quarter_end
),
ordered_quarters AS (
    SELECT
        r.*,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY r.cik, r.fiscal_year
            ORDER BY r.quarter_end
        ) AS quarter_index,
        LAG(r.cfo_ytd) OVER (
            PARTITION BY r.cik, r.fiscal_year

    SELECT
        o.cik,
        o.fiscal_year,
        o.fp,
        o.quarter_end,
        CASE
            WHEN o.quarter_index = 1 THEN o.cfo_ytd
            WHEN o.prev_cfo_ytd IS NULL THEN NULL
            ELSE o.cfo_ytd - o.prev_cfo_ytd
        END AS cfo_quarter
    FROM ordered_quarters o
),
filtered_series AS (
    SELECT
        sc.company_name AS company,
        sc.canonical_name,
        qc.quarter_end,
        qc.fiscal_year,
        qc.fp,
        qc.cfo_quarter

      AND qc.quarter_end BETWEEN DATE '2021-09-01' AND DATE '2024-12-31'

coverage AS (

        fs.company,
        fs.canonical_name,
        fs.quarter_end,
        fs.fiscal_year,

    JOIN coverage c USING (canonical_name)

    fp AS fiscal_period,

FROM final_series
ORDER BY quarter_end, company
LIMIT 500;

Question: Which Technology companies increased EBITDA margins the most between FY2021 and FY2024?
Business_context: Identify capital-efficient tech franchises
SQL_generated:
WITH sector_candidates AS (
    SELECT
        c.cik,
        c.name,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY c.cik
            ORDER BY
                CASE WHEN UPPER(c.name) LIKE '% INC%' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,
                LENGTH(TRIM(c.name)),
                UPPER(c.name)
        ) AS rn
    FROM companies c
    WHERE LOWER(c.gics_sector) LIKE LOWER('%Technology%')
),
sector_companies AS (
    SELECT
        cik,
        name,
        REGEXP_REPLACE(UPPER(TRIM(name)), '[^A-Z0-9]', '', 'g') AS canonical_name
    FROM sector_candidates
    WHERE rn = 1
),
ranked_filings AS (
    SELECT
        s.adsh,
        s.cik,
        CAST(s.fy AS INTEGER) AS fiscal_year,
        s.period,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.cik, s.fy ORDER BY s.filed DESC) AS rn
    FROM sub s
    JOIN sector_companies sc USING (cik)
    WHERE s.form IN ('10-K','10-K/A')
      AND s.fy BETWEEN 2021 AND 2024
),
latest_filings AS (
    SELECT adsh, cik, fiscal_year, period
    FROM ranked_filings
    WHERE rn = 1
),
annual_values AS (
    SELECT
        lf.cik,
        lf.fiscal_year,
        MAX(CASE WHEN n.tag IN (
            'OperatingIncomeLoss',
            'IncomeLossFromContinuingOperationsBeforeIncomeTaxesExtraordinaryItemsNoncontrollingInterest'
        ) THEN n.value END) AS operating_income,
        MAX(CASE WHEN n.tag IN (
            'DepreciationDepletionAndAmortization',
            'DepreciationAndAmortization',
            'DepreciationAmortizationAndAccretionNet',
            'AmortizationOfIntangibleAssets',
            'Depreciation'
        ) THEN n.value END) AS depreciation,
        MAX(CASE WHEN n.tag IN (
            'Revenues',
            'RevenueFromContractWithCustomerExcludingAssessedTax',
            'SalesRevenueNet',
            'NetSales'
        ) THEN n.value END) AS revenue
    FROM latest_filings lf
    JOIN num n ON n.adsh = lf.adsh AND n.ddate = lf.period
    WHERE n.tag IN (
        'OperatingIncomeLoss',
        'IncomeLossFromContinuingOperationsBeforeIncomeTaxesExtraordinaryItemsNoncontrollingInterest',
        'DepreciationDepletionAndAmortization',
        'DepreciationAndAmortization',
        'DepreciationAmortizationAndAccretionNet',
        'AmortizationOfIntangibleAssets',
        'Depreciation',
        'Revenues',
        'RevenueFromContractWithCustomerExcludingAssessedTax',
        'SalesRevenueNet',
        'NetSales'
    )
      AND COALESCE(TRIM(n.segments), '') = ''
      AND COALESCE(TRIM(n.coreg), '') = ''
    GROUP BY lf.cik, lf.fiscal_year
),
margin_series AS (
    SELECT
        sc.canonical_name,
        ANY_VALUE(sc.name) AS display_name,
        av.fiscal_year,
        AVG((COALESCE(av.operating_income, 0) + COALESCE(av.depreciation, 0)) / NULLIF(av.revenue, 0)) AS ebitda_margin,
        MAX(av.revenue) AS revenue
    FROM annual_values av
    JOIN sector_companies sc USING (cik)
    WHERE av.revenue IS NOT NULL
      AND av.operating_income IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY sc.canonical_name, av.fiscal_year
),
aggregated AS (
    SELECT
        canonical_name,
        ANY_VALUE(display_name) AS display_name,
        MAX(CASE WHEN fiscal_year = 2021 THEN ebitda_margin END) AS margin_2021,
        MAX(CASE WHEN fiscal_year = 2024 THEN ebitda_margin END) AS margin_2024,
        MAX(CASE WHEN fiscal_year = 2024 THEN revenue END) AS revenue_2024
    FROM margin_series
    GROUP BY canonical_name
)
SELECT
    display_name AS name,
    ROUND(margin_2021 * 100, 2) AS margin_2021_pct,
    ROUND(margin_2024 * 100, 2) AS margin_2024_pct,
    ROUND((margin_2024 - margin_2021) * 100, 2) AS improvement_pp,
    ROUND(revenue_2024 / 1000000000.0, 2) AS revenue_2024_billions
FROM aggregated
WHERE margin_2021 IS NOT NULL
  AND margin_2024 IS NOT NULL
  AND revenue_2024 >= 2000000000
  AND ((margin_2024 - margin_2021) * 100) >= 5
ORDER BY improvement_pp DESC,
         revenue_2024_billions DESC,
         name
LIMIT 10;

    UNION ALL

    FROM combined_companies
    GROUP BY cik
),
annual_filings AS (
    SELECT
        s.adsh,
        s.cik,
        CAST(s.fy AS INTEGER) AS fiscal_year,
        s.period,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY s.cik, s.fy
            ORDER BY s.filed DESC, s.period DESC NULLS LAST
        ) AS rn
    FROM sub s
    JOIN company_dim cd USING (cik)
    WHERE s.form IN ('10-K', '10-K/A')
      AND s.fy BETWEEN 2019 AND 2024
),
latest_filings AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM annual_filings
    WHERE rn = 1
      AND period IS NOT NULL
),
annual_values AS (
    SELECT
        lf.cik,
        lf.fiscal_year,
        MAX(CASE WHEN n.tag = 'CashAndCashEquivalentsAtCarryingValue' THEN n.value END) AS cash_and_equivalents,
        MAX(CASE WHEN n.tag = 'CashCashEquivalentsAndShortTermInvestments' THEN n.value END) AS cash_and_short_term,
        MAX(CASE WHEN n.tag = 'Assets' THEN n.value END) AS total_assets
    FROM latest_filings lf
    JOIN num n
      ON n.adsh = lf.adsh
     AND n.ddate = lf.period
    WHERE n.tag IN (
        'CashAndCashEquivalentsAtCarryingValue',
        'CashCashEquivalentsAndShortTermInvestments',
        'Assets'
    )
      AND COALESCE(TRIM(n.segments), '') = ''
      AND COALESCE(TRIM(n.coreg), '') = ''
    GROUP BY lf.cik, lf.fiscal_year

normalized AS (
    SELECT
        av.cik,
        av.fiscal_year,

        av.total_assets

ratios AS (

        cd.display_name AS company,

Question: Compare quarterly gross margin trends for Apple, Dell, and HP over the past 8 quarters.
Business_context: Understand hardware margin dynamics
SQL_generated:
WITH provided_companies AS (
    SELECT
        TRIM(company_name) AS requested_name,
        REGEXP_REPLACE(UPPER(TRIM(company_name)), '[^A-Z0-9]', '', 'g') AS canonical_key
    FROM (VALUES ('APPLE INC'),('DELL TECHNOLOGIES INC.'),('HP INC')) AS t(company_name)
),
company_dim AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        c.cik,
        pc.requested_name,
        c.name AS company_name,
        pc.canonical_key
    FROM companies c
    JOIN provided_companies pc
      ON REGEXP_REPLACE(UPPER(TRIM(c.name)), '[^A-Z0-9]', '', 'g') = pc.canonical_key
),
ranked_filings AS (
    SELECT
        s.adsh,
        s.cik,
        s.period AS period_end,
        CAST(s.fy AS INTEGER) AS fiscal_year,
        s.fp,
        s.filed,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY s.cik, s.period
            ORDER BY s.filed DESC
        ) AS filing_rank
    FROM sub s
    JOIN company_dim cd USING (cik)
    WHERE s.form IN ('10-Q', '10-Q/A')
      AND s.fp IN ('Q1', 'Q2', 'Q3', 'Q4')
      AND s.period >= DATE '2022-01-01'
),
latest_filings AS (
    SELECT
        rf.adsh,
        rf.cik,
        rf.period_end,
        rf.fiscal_year,
        rf.fp,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY rf.cik
            ORDER BY rf.period_end DESC
        ) AS seq
    FROM ranked_filings rf
    WHERE rf.filing_rank = 1
),
selected_filings AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM latest_filings
    WHERE seq <= 8
),
quarter_values AS (
    SELECT
        sf.cik,
        sf.period_end,
        sf.fiscal_year,
        sf.fp,
        MAX(
            CASE
                WHEN n.tag IN (
                    'Revenues',
                    'RevenueFromContractWithCustomerExcludingAssessedTax',
                    'SalesRevenueNet',
                    'NetSalesRevenue',
                    'NetSales'
                )
                AND COALESCE(n.qtrs, 1) IN (0, 1)
                THEN n.value
            END
        ) AS revenue,
        MAX(
            CASE
                WHEN n.tag IN (
                    'CostOfRevenue',
                    'CostOfGoodsAndServicesSold',
                    'CostOfGoodsSold'
                )
                AND COALESCE(n.qtrs, 1) IN (0, 1)
                THEN n.value
            END
        ) AS cost_of_revenue
    FROM selected_filings sf
    JOIN num n
      ON n.adsh = sf.adsh
     AND n.ddate = sf.period_end
    WHERE n.tag IN (
        'Revenues',
        'RevenueFromContractWithCustomerExcludingAssessedTax',
        'SalesRevenueNet',
        'NetSalesRevenue',
        'NetSales',
        'CostOfRevenue',
        'CostOfGoodsAndServicesSold',
        'CostOfGoodsSold'
    )
      AND COALESCE(TRIM(n.segments), '') = ''
      AND COALESCE(TRIM(n.coreg), '') = ''
    GROUP BY sf.cik, sf.period_end, sf.fiscal_year, sf.fp
),
coverage AS (
    SELECT cik
    FROM quarter_values
    WHERE revenue IS NOT NULL
      AND cost_of_revenue IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY cik
    HAVING COUNT(*) >= 8
),
normalized AS (
    SELECT
        cd.company_name AS company,
        cd.requested_name,
        q.period_end,
        q.fiscal_year,
        q.fp,
        q.revenue,
        q.cost_of_revenue,
        CASE
            WHEN q.revenue IS NULL OR q.revenue = 0 THEN NULL
            ELSE (q.revenue - q.cost_of_revenue) / q.revenue
        END AS gross_margin_ratio
    FROM quarter_values q
    JOIN company_dim cd USING (cik)
    JOIN coverage cv USING (cik)
),
ranked_series AS (
    SELECT
        n.*,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY n.company
            ORDER BY n.period_end
        ) AS seq_asc,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY n.company
            ORDER BY n.period_end DESC
        ) AS seq_desc
    FROM normalized n
),
summary AS (
    SELECT
        company,
        MIN(period_end) AS baseline_period,
        MAX(period_end) AS latest_period,
        MAX(CASE WHEN seq_asc = 1 THEN gross_margin_ratio END) AS baseline_margin,
        MAX(CASE WHEN seq_desc = 1 THEN gross_margin_ratio END) AS latest_margin,
        MAX(CASE WHEN seq_desc = 1 THEN revenue END) AS latest_revenue,
        MAX(CASE WHEN seq_desc = 1 THEN cost_of_revenue END) AS latest_cost,
        COUNT(*) AS quarters_available
    FROM ranked_series
    GROUP BY company
)
SELECT
    rs.company,
    summary.quarters_available,
    summary.baseline_period,
    summary.latest_period,
    ROUND(summary.baseline_margin * 100, 1) AS baseline_margin_pct,
    ROUND(summary.latest_margin * 100, 1) AS latest_margin_pct,
    ROUND((summary.latest_margin - summary.baseline_margin) * 100, 1) AS margin_change_pp,
    ROUND(summary.latest_revenue / 1e9, 2) AS latest_revenue_billions,
    ROUND(summary.latest_cost / 1e9, 2) AS latest_cost_billions,
    rs.period_end,
    rs.fiscal_year,
    rs.fp,
    CONCAT(
        CAST(EXTRACT(year FROM rs.period_end) AS VARCHAR),
        ' Q',
        CAST(EXTRACT(quarter FROM rs.period_end) AS VARCHAR)
    ) AS quarter_label,
    ROUND(rs.revenue / 1e9, 3) AS revenue_billions,
    ROUND(rs.cost_of_revenue / 1e9, 3) AS cost_of_revenue_billions,
    ROUND(rs.gross_margin_ratio * 100, 1) AS gross_margin_pct,
    rs.seq_asc AS quarter_index_asc,
    rs.seq_desc AS quarter_index_desc
FROM ranked_series rs
JOIN summary USING (company)
ORDER BY rs.company, rs.period_end;
